_note: 2 Frenzy achievements (src/constants.js FRENZY_FIRST_ACH_ID / FRENZY_DOUBLE_ACH_ID, 18.x). Same array shape: [title, post-earned description, pre-earned description]. Play Console has ONE description field - use the pre-earned string there. Titles use each locale's in-game Frenzy word (src/i18n.js `frenzy`). Icons: achievement-icons/frenzy_first.png, frenzy_double.png (gen-frenzy-achievement-icons.py). Suggested points: frenzy_first 20, frenzy_double 50 (measured: only the pro pilot tier reaches a second star). Hidden: No. Incremental: No.
